name: Otterly.AI
summary: Track your brand's visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI.
description: Otterly.AI monitors how a brand, its products and competitors appear in AI search answers. It tracks mentions and cited links and helps improve visibility in these new search channels.
